-- test.glx --
persons:
  someone:
    properties:
      name:
        value: Someone
        fields:
          monkey: "undefined field"

-- want-error --
persons\[someone\].Properties.name.Fields: field discarded: unknown field "monkey"

-- want-catalog.yaml --

    someone:
        properties:
            name:
                definition:
                    label: Name
                    value_type: string
